summary: The client schema, the generated TypeScript client and the Swift error codes list large enums one case per line, so two changes that add different cases no longer conflict

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: The client schema parses to the same JSON and the wire contract is identical; only the layout of the schema file and of the generated clients changes.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: Nothing a client or peer sees changes.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
